mike: hi all, first day! i need console env access: qa admin to test feature flags in my onboarding checklist, prod readonly to view runbooks. fastest way?
nina: welcome mike :tada: open infra-permissions ticket with manager approval. include which flags you'll touch and duration.
mike: can someone paste the exact ticket body?
nina: use this:
```
Title: Env panel request - mike
Requester: mike
Manager: <mgr-name>
Environments: qa (admin), prod (readonly)
Flags: onboarding.feature_x, onboarding.logging
Duration: 7 days
Reason: onboarding verification + runbook walkthrough
```
access-bot: tip: after infra updates, verify via Console -> avatar -> "My permissions" or `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/v1/me/roles` and look for `"env_panel"`. If mismatch, ping @nina.
mike: filed ticket INF-4901 and added manager signoff. thanks!
nina: approved in ticket, infra should act today. i'll follow up here when it's done.
access-bot: system note: QA admin flips are logged and monitored. avoid flipping during daily deploy window (15:00-16:00 UTC).
mike: got it, thanks everyone :)
